key_catalyst: Oil sinks 4% on renewed US-Iran talk hopes, easing the MACRO_SHOCK overhang
reasoning: The morning SELL thesis centered on Iran/oil escalation as the dominant macro risk, but intraday developments show the opposite trajectory — crude fell 4% on renewed US-Iran talk hopes, and the S&P 500 actually rose, indicating the macro risk is resolving rather than escalating. QQQ's -0.90% decline is almost entirely attributable to GOOGL's -7% earnings-driven selloff (a single-stock event), with the broad market demonstrating resilience. With the primary catalyst de-escalating and the earnings drag largely absorbed during today's session, overnight gap-down risk is not material.
